prompt: A flat layered paper-cut collage in a strict handcraft design system: everything is cut from colored cardstock and hanji paper with perfectly clean cut edges — NO outline of any kind on any piece: no bright edge line, no white edge, no dark contour line. Each object is built from two to five completely flat die-cut pieces layered ON THE OBJECT ITSELF — its own silhouette, a main color piece, one or two detail pieces and a highlight piece — the object is never placed on a base, platform, pedestal, plinth or pile of paper sheets; Every upper piece sits slightly RAISED above the piece beneath it, so along EVERY boundary where two different colors meet, the upper piece casts a soft narrow warm dark-brown shadow down onto the lower piece — a gentle embossed paper relief wherever two colors touch, and this relief shadow is the ONLY depth cue. Cut economy: every scissor cut is purposeful and confident — a shape that is straight in the real object is cut with a clean STRAIGHT edge, and curves appear ONLY where the real object is actually curved. No decorative wavy edges, no bumpy wobbly outlines, no gratuitous scalloping on untextured surfaces; a rectangular block is cut as a plain rectangle, though corners may be gently ROUNDED — softly rounding a corner is natural scissor work. Shapes stay simple and chunky, no detail finer than real scissors could cut. Scalloped repeat patterns for textures like straw or waves, cut big and loose. Strictly straight-on orthographic front view, zero perspective. No volume, no curvature, no folded paper, no sculpting. Real-scissors discipline: every piece is a shape that could actually be cut with scissors from a single sheet of colored paper. EACH PIECE IS EXACTLY ONE SOLID FLAT COLOR — no gradient, no shading, no airbrush, no painted detail inside a piece; every color change is a separate stacked paper piece, even a thin line is its own paper strip. ALL pieces share one identical fine colored-paper texture. All shadows are neutral warm dark-brown paper shadows, never colored. Cute, round, friendly Korean picture-book characters for 3-4 year olds: big round white paper eyes with dark pupils, small pink cheek circles, simple rounded shapes, never scary. The dog: a cute small white dog made of flat paper pieces, designed from the reference photo — cream-white body, chest, muzzle and face; the face is entirely cream-white with NO colored patch around either eye (at most a very faint tan wash beside the eyes); the dog's two ears are DIFFERENT: one ear is SOLID tan-orange paper, the OTHER ear is white paper with a pink inside and a few small yellow-tan paper spots dotted on its outer side. Because the dog faces RIGHT, its near ear (drawn big, in front, at the back of the head) is the SOLID tan-orange one and its far ear (upright behind the head) is the white, pink-inside, tan-spotted one. A black nose, bright dark round eyes, small pink cheeks, pink tongue, wearing a bright sky-blue harness with a tiny white strap label. Same dog in every picture, never brown all over, never both ears orange, never both ears plain white. Side view facing RIGHT, leaping happily through the air, ears flying, tongue out. Shown whole and uncropped, centered. Isolated on a plain solid flat lime green (#7CFC00) background, nothing else. The paper pieces cast NO shadow onto the lime area: no drop shadow, no ground shadow, no backing shape — only tiny shallow shadows between their own stacked pieces. Do NOT paint any glow, halo or colour onto the lime background; the lime stays one perfectly flat uniform colour right up to the paper edges. No text, no watermark.

The dog: a cute small white dog made of flat paper pieces, designed from the reference photo — cream-white body, chest, muzzle and face; the face is entirely cream-white with NO colored patch around either eye (at most a very faint tan wash beside the eyes); the dog's two ears are DIFFERENT: one ear is SOLID tan-orange paper, the OTHER ear is white paper with a pink inside and a few small yellow-tan paper spots dotted on its outer side. Because the dog faces RIGHT, its near ear (drawn big, in front, at the back of the head) is the SOLID tan-orange one and its far ear (upright behind the head) is the white, pink-inside, tan-spotted one. A black nose, bright dark round eyes, small pink cheeks, pink tongue, wearing a bright sky-blue harness with a tiny white strap label. Same dog in every picture, never brown all over, never both ears orange, never both ears plain white. The cat: a cute golden-yellow cat made of flat paper pieces — three persimmon-orange tabby stripes on its back, pointed ears with pink insides, a small pink nose, short whiskers, a tall upright tail, bright round eyes, pink cheeks.  Colour mood: soft, muted, gentle picture-book pastels with low saturation — the sky is a pale soft blue fading to a very light warm cream near the horizon (never saturated yellow, never lime), greens are calm sage and pine greens, water is a soft muted teal-blue (never purple). No text anywhere. Full-bleed illustration, no lime green.
